name: Helix
source:
elix was the only love interest in the original novel series (who was named Maelstrom) and is the 'cannon' route here. Helix is the hero you need to survive this horrible planet. How long can you resist this charming mine-lord?

[From [url=https://ypressgames.itch.io/maelstrom]Itch.io[/url]]
